links.note: UNLINK. Was 25290 'अकेला सवार'. The item is a पदबंध drill -- 'हरिहर काका धीरे-धीरे चलते हुए आँगन तक पहुँचे', asking the type of the underlined phrase. हरिहर काका is not even in this lesson. No concept here covers पदबंध.

UNLINK. Was 25292 'जान बख़्शी'. The item is a सरल वाक्य transformation drill, and its sentence is about तताँरा and वामीरो -- content of chapter 23763, not of कारतूस. Wrong on both counts: a grammar exercise, and a foreign lesson's material.
UNLINK. Was 25273 'लोकनाट्य में योगदान'. The item asks which मुहावरा means 'अयोग्य को कोई महत्त्वपूर्ण वस्तु मिलना' (अंधे के हाथ बटेर लगना). A pure idiom drill; nothing about folk theatre is tested.

RE-LINK from 25280 'जंगल की ज़िंदगी'. The question is 'कर्नल को खेमे की तरफ़ कौन आता दिखाई दिया' and its answer is 'एक सवार' -- which is 25290 'अकेला सवार' by name. 25280 is the band's life in the forest, a different beat.

RE-LINK from 25284 'सआदत अली कौन'. The question is WHY Saadat Ali was put on the throne, and the keyed answer is that he would serve the English -- which is the bargain 25286 'आधी मुल्कियत का सौदा' describes. 25284 answers who he was, not the terms.
RE-LINK from 25284 'सआदत अली कौन'. 'सआदत अली ने अंग्रेज़ों को कितने रुपए दिए' keys १० लाख, and 25286 states दस लाख रुपये नक़द in its own text. The sum is part of the bargain, not of his identity.
